honest_boundaries: Hamilton's surface theorem is a state-only Prop (HamiltonSurfaceTheoremStatement); it is neither proved nor axiomatized.

The Bernstein–Bando–Shi smoothing estimates are state-only Props (BernsteinBandoShiSurfaceStatement, BernsteinBandoShiUnnormalizedStatement); the covariant-derivative norm is the interface CovariantDerivativeProfile.

The toy ODE is the homogeneous model reduction (Δ scal dropped). The forward normalized flow gives scal' = scal(scal - r); without diffusion this cannot by itself produce convergence to constant curvature. The backward-normalized flow gives the logistic equation scal' = scal(r - scal) with limit r.
Area preservation for the general (non-homogeneous) case uses the Reynolds transport formula as an explicit hypothesis; the homogeneous case scal = r is proved with no transport hypothesis.
The 2D interface is local-coordinate 2×2 matrix algebra, not manifold-level Riemannian geometry.
